database:primary-key:post.decision: uuid primary key for every post; B's integer ids kept in legacy_id (unique, nullable) during and after migration

database:field-type:post.author_id.decision: author_id is uuid referencing users.id; B's integer author ids are rewritten through the user legacy_id map

api:contract:GET /api/posts/{} response.decision: One contract: {id: uuid, body: text, status: pending|published|rejected, author: {id: uuid, display_name: text}, created_at}. No integer-id compatibility layer (no B API clients are known)

api:endpoint-auth:GET /api/posts/{}.decision: One cookie-session auth; GET /api/posts/:id is public for published posts, author or moderator only for pending/rejected (404 otherwise)

application:authorization-model:model.decision: Role-based model with one can(user, action, resource) check used by every handler; actions: post.create, post.read_unpublished, moderation.list, moderation.decide

application:roles:roles.decision: Unified roles member and moderator. Map A member->member, A moderator->moderator, B user->member, B admin->member (least privilege: admin had no observed powers); former B admins are listed for the user to promote by hand

application:session:session.decision: Server-side session in an http-only, secure, same-site cookie; no bearer tokens

application:auth-methods:methods.decision: Email + password only, through the one identity system

database:duplicate-entity:post.decision: One posts table; status from A; B rows get status published (see publish-policy)

application:workflow:publish-policy.decision: Every new post is pending until a moderator decides; B's existing posts migrate as published

application:business-rule:max-post-lengt.decision: Unified limit 10000 characters (server validation and DB check)

database:nullability:post.author_id.decision: Legacy anonymous B posts are assigned to a reserved sign-in-disabled system account; author_id stays not null

database:data-migration:user-accounts.decision: Re-key B users to uuid with legacy_id; name -> display_name; same-email accounts merged into A's record; password reset required where B's hash format cannot be verified. Approved as a plan only; running it needs a separate approval

application:security:b-token-signing-key.decision: B's token code is not reused; B tokens are invalid at cut-over; session secret from configuration only

migration:post.decision: Re-key B posts to uuid with legacy_id, rewrite author_id through the user map, add status=published to B rows. Approved as a plan only (design/migration-plan.md); running it needs a separate approval
